text:
Ava: Quick plan for Tue launch — tiered posts across X + LinkedIn. Need final assets (GIF + static), two caption variants (technical vs product), and the webinar CTA + registration link. Who can claim copy, image final, and scheduling?

Priya: I'll take X copy + the thread. Thinking we A/B headline: "Inference at scale" vs "Cut inference costs". Will draft 2 thread variants today.

Diego: I can own LinkedIn longform + hero image. Which webinar URL should we use (trackable)? Also need the official benchmark stat to highlight.

Sam: SDR routing check — registrants from X should go to SDR queue `launch-web-x` and LinkedIn registrants to `launch-web-ln`. Confirm? We need clear UTM tags for both.

Marta: Assets update — GIF animation is ready but needs a 1s trim on the loop. I'll upload final frames to Figma in ~20m and add export for web. @Diego I'll attach the hero crop.

Hannah: For messaging, let's include one benchmark card: single stat (e.g., "50% lower per-token cost in our config") + link to benchmark blog. Also want a separate microthread (3 tweets) with deep-dive for engineers.

Ravi: Proposed posting schedule (staggered to hit NA + EMEA):
```
Tue 08:00 PT — X (headline A)
Tue 11:00 ET — LinkedIn (longform + hero)
Tue 16:00 GMT — X follow-up (tech thread / benchmark card)
Wed 09:00 APAC — repost LinkedIn summary
```
Can SchedBot reserve these slots?

Priya: Adding CTA variants:
- Product: "See live demo + sign up" (webinar reg)
- Technical: "Dig into the benchmark + join the webinar" (webinar reg + blog link)
Will include both in thread variants.

Sam: Confirming SDR routing and UTMs: use `utm_source=x|ln`, `utm_medium=social`, `utm_campaign=launch_apr`. Example: `...?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_apr&utm_content=threadA`

Ava: Nice. Also add influencer seed list (small set) — Hannah can you DM the list to @Marta so we can prepare tags? We want one organic push from partner on launch day.

Marta: Will do. Uploading assets to Figma now, will post links here when done. ETA 25m.

Diego: Draft LinkedIn posted in drive — needs one editorial pass. @Ava can you review tone (product vs growth)?

Ava: I'll review in 30. Note: keep benchmark claim copy consistent with legal-approved phrasing — Hannah, can you confirm the exact stat text?

Hannah: Legal-approved phrasing: "Observed up to 50% reduction in per-token inference cost under our recommended config. Results vary by workload." I'll paste the approved snippet into the doc.

SchedBot: Slots reserved. Use `/schedule post 3301204567` to queue content. Posting windows locked: 08:00 PT, 11:00 ET, 16:00 GMT.

Priya: Uploaded X thread drafts to the shared doc: threadA (product-first) + threadB (technical-first). Need one edit pass from @Diego for image alt text and @Sam for CTA landing.

Sam: I'll confirm the SDR hooks once we have final reg form. Who owns the reg form?

Ava: Growth owns reg form — cc @Diego to sync with them now.

Diego: Syncing with Growth. Will ping when reg form link is final and attach UTM examples.

Marta: Final assets uploaded: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/example/launch-assets — files labelled `hero_v3.png`, `launch_loop.gif`.

Priya: Copy note: for X thread keep first tweet tight (< 200 chars) and include CTAs + short link. For LinkedIn use 2-3 paragraphs, with benchmark card image.

Ava: Target: finalize copy + assets by EOD today so scheduling team can queue for Tue. If anyone hits blockers, flag here. :thumbsup:

Diego: :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll test the SDR routing tomorrow morning once reg link is live.

Hannah: I'll seed the benchmark card into the thread and DM influencer list to @Marta.

Marta: Got it. Ping me if you need alternate aspect ratios.

Ava: Great team. Final checklist: assets uploaded, copy approved, reg link live with UTMs, SDR routing confirmed, slots reserved. We should be green by EOD.

Priya: On it — will post final links here when ready.
